note: Every crafting item drop picks one item from this table, weighted by weight. Item rarity reshapes the weights: each item weighs the table total times its share of the table to the power 1 / rarity^0.4 (CraftingDrops.RARITY_FLATTENING), so at 1x the weights are as written and higher rarity gives rarer items a larger share without changing how many drop. Rarity is the chart tier's crafting_rarity (star_chart_tiers.csv, 1x outside charts) times the increased rarity of the item's crafting item subcategory. Each source sets only how many drop and which items it may give. chart_only items drop only from Star Charts sources. Weights are the old tier 15 chart drops per 100 DP, rare and higher divided by tier 15's old band shift (docs/analysis/chart_loot/rarity_band_model.js); docs/analysis/chart_loot/crafting_rarity_model.js sets each tier's crafting_rarity.
